# P02 strict JSON: finite float support must not admit IEEE exponent overflow.
import hashlib
class FiniteJSONRegression(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_overflow_tokens_are_rejected(self):
  for text in ['1e309','-1e309','[1e309]']:
   with self.subTest(text=text), self.assertRaisesRegex(m.PlannerError,'unsupported JSON number'):
    codec.parse_json(text,allow_floats=True)
 def test_finite_float_compatibility(self):
  for text in ['1.25','1e308','-1e308']:
   with self.subTest(text=text):self.assertEqual(codec.parse_json(text,allow_floats=True),float(text))
 def test_nonfinite_constants_stay_rejected(self):
  for text in ['NaN','Infinity','-Infinity']:
   with self.subTest(text=text), self.assertRaises(m.PlannerError):codec.parse_json(text,allow_floats=True)
 def test_pinned_embedded_overflow_is_rejected(self):
  path=Path('.scratch/overflow.json');path.write_bytes(b'1e309')
  pin=m.ArtifactPin(str(path),m.ArtifactIdentity(m.IdentityKind.CONTENT_IDENTITY,m.HashProfile.E1_EMBEDDED_JSON.value,hashlib.sha256(b'Infinity').hexdigest()),m.HashProfile.E1_EMBEDDED_JSON)
  with self.assertRaisesRegex(m.PlannerError,'unsupported JSON number'):codec.load_pinned(Path.cwd(),pin)
 def test_pinned_embedded_finite_float_is_accepted(self):
  path=Path('.scratch/finite.json');path.write_bytes(b'1.25')
  pin=m.ArtifactPin(str(path),m.ArtifactIdentity(m.IdentityKind.CONTENT_IDENTITY,m.HashProfile.E1_EMBEDDED_JSON.value,hashlib.sha256(b'1.25').hexdigest()),m.HashProfile.E1_EMBEDDED_JSON)
  self.assertEqual(codec.load_pinned(Path.cwd(),pin),1.25)
",encoding="utf-8")
